subject: Adding a clean option for build script (#66)
reason: The change adds a 'clean' option to build.sh (rm -rf build/) and documents it in README.md. It is purely a build-script and documentation change: no module source, command handling, serialization, or runtime behaviour is touched, so the loaded valkey-json module is byte-for-byte identical in behaviour at the change and its parent. There is nothing a runtime scenario could exercise.
